name: Susukino Obana
source:
The head of the OCTA branch where Kuraugi was demoted.
Despite being the head of the branch, she has a lackadaisical attitude towards work and is often seen taking naps on the sofa at work or playing with local amateur baseball teams under the guise of patrols.
